Here's a concise, professional apology email you can adapt:

---

**Subject:** Apology / [Brief context, e.g., "Missed deadline" or "Meeting conflict"]

Hi [Name],

I’m sorry for [specific issue — e.g., missing our 2 PM sync / sending the draft late / not looping you in earlier]. It impacted [you / the team / the timeline] and that wasn’t my intention.

[Optional: one sentence on what happened, no excuses — e.g., "I misjudged the review time needed."]

Going forward, I’ll [concrete fix — e.g., "block review time on my calendar upfront" / "flag dependencies earlier" / "confirm receipt on time-sensitive items"].

Thanks for your patience — let me know if there’s anything I can do to smooth things over.

Best,  
[Your name]
